What am I seeing?

Brightness shows simulated firing rate. Yellow rings mark directly stimulated neurons. Colors identify the neuron’s role.

This is a motor-circuit subset including the ventral nerve cord, not a whole brain. Its connections and positions come from MaleCNS; its dynamics and demonstration inputs are modeled.

Transmitter labels are annotations, not chemical measurements. Dopamine concentration is not simulated.

The microphone’s volume, reply-generation state, and audible playback stimulate selected cells. Activity then evolves through the circuit. Silence removes the audio input; there are no automatic demo pulses.

The sensory cells here sense legs, not sound. This is an engineered conversation display, not a biological model of hearing or language. The circuit does not choose Eric’s words or move the fly.
